title: Jacobs: the abduction program aims at planetary takeover by stealth

tellings.quote: Well, David Jacobs said that the endgame of the abduction program was planetary acquisition by stealth.

plain: The historian David Jacobs, who spent years studying people who say beings took them from their beds, concluded that the endgame of this abduction "program" was "planetary acquisition by stealth": a quiet takeover of Earth. The filmmaker Tim Alberino gives Michels this as Jacobs's view, drawing on Jacobs's book Walking Among Us. If it were true, the abductions would be part of a plan and not random visits.
